svg.title: My learning map — Introduction to Java
svg.desc: All 31 explicitly learned topics, grouped by real Hyperskill categories. Twelve also have verified status. Arrows are selected prerequisites, not chronology or application evidence. Numeric literals is unconnected in the learned prerequisite graph.

g.text: Every dot is learned. An outer ring adds verified.
